_about: Chennai test data for infrastructure/local/scripts/seed-chennai.mjs. Business and people names are made up; the places, streets and coordinates are real Chennai neighbourhoods (coordinates checked against OpenStreetMap). GSTIN and FSSAI numbers only have the right format. Every account is approved; its password is the "password" value below, unless the entry has its own "password" (the development accounts). Store products are catalog codes: PRD… from infrastructure/local/seed/catalog/products.csv, CHN… (branded) from products.csv next to this file. A store's optional "stockScale" multiplies the products' opening stock, and "outOfStock" lists the products it opens with none of.

development._about: The sign-in screen's development accounts (identity-service creates them when DEV_SEED_ENABLED=true; their password is their own "password", not the shared one), one of each role, close together in Velachery, for testing the whole workflow by hand (README: "Development accounts"). infrastructure/local/scripts/verify-workflow.mjs runs a grocery and a restaurant order through all four.
